plan: In a single-round sealed bid auction with an ascending clock, the optimal strategy is to bid close to, but slightly below my true value of $26. This protects my potential profit margin. Since values are randomly drawn and this is a one-time game, I'll bid strategically at $25.5 - just under my true value but high enough to have a good chance of winning while preserving potential profit if the auction price rises.

This is a single round with a private value of $31. Since the goal is to maximize long-term profit, I'll aim to bid strategically. With 3 bidders and values between $0-$49, I want to bid close to my true value but not exactly at it. A bid around 80-90% of my value ($25-$28) could balance winning probability with profit margin. This reduces risk of overpaying while still having a competitive chance of winning.

My private value is $24. In a sealed bid auction with two other bidders, I want to bid strategically to maximize potential profit. Since the value is randomly drawn, I'll aim to bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. A bid around $22-$23 gives me a chance to win while protecting potential earnings. This allows some margin if the auction price escalates, ensuring I don't overpay relative to my true value.
